How Long Is the Immigration Queue at Tan Son Nhat Airport in October 2026?

In October 2026, based on flight schedules and official airport data from 2024–2026, passengers landing during the busiest hours at Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN) could spend 111–133 minutes completing immigration procedures. With Fast Track, this time is under 20 minutes at any hour.

When Fast Track matters most

Flights landing 16:00–24:00, when arrivals from Bangkok, Singapore, Taipei and Hong Kong land minutes apart. Land 06:00–13:00 — the line is shorter, though rarely short.

October 2026 notes

China’s National Day week runs to the 7th and lifts the mainland routes — about a fifth of the daily arrivals. The winter schedule then starts on the 25th, bringing Chiang Mai and Cebu back to the board.

How we estimate: a minute-by-minute queue model over the 145 international arrivals on a representative October day, counting deplaning and the walk to the hall, and checked against the daily immigration volume the airport publishes.

What We Offer

What Is Airport Fast Track?

Tan Son Nhat Airport (SGN) serves over 40 million passengers a year — nearly double its designed capacity. Fast Track is a licensed airport assistance service that gets you through immigration in under 20 minutes, while everyone else waits up to two hours.

Peak hours — SGN T2

The Queue Is Real

This is the real immigration hall at Ho Chi Minh Airport during peak hours. Overnight flights from Seoul, Tokyo, and Sydney all land at once — 60 to 120 minutes of standing in line, before your trip even begins.

Your name. Our sign.

We're Already Waiting

Step into Terminal 2 and our staff is already there — holding a sign with your name. No searching for the right exit, no confusion between T1 and T2. Just follow and relax.

Priority Lane — SGN T2

Through in Under 20 Minutes

We handle visa stamping, immigration forms, and customs — then escort you straight to the exit. While the regular queue is still halfway through the hall, you're already in Saigon.

The Difference

Your First Hour in Ho Chi Minh City

Without Fast Track

Join hundreds of passengers in the SGN immigration hall — 60 to 120 minutes, sometimes more during Tet or peak summer

Navigate Vietnamese-language signs alone — and hope you went to the right terminal

Sort out visa stamping on your own — queues at the VOA counter can add another 30–60 minutes

Exit the terminal straight into Saigon traffic — already exhausted from the queue

Arrive at your hotel stressed and drained — before your Saigon trip even begins

vs

With Fast Track

Walk straight to the priority lane — clear immigration in under 20 minutes, regardless of how many other passengers just landed

Our staff is waiting at Terminal 2 — right terminal, right door, right on time

We handle immigration forms, visa stamp, and customs — you just hand over your passport

Exit the terminal faster — and get ahead of the Saigon rush-hour traffic before it builds

Arrive at your hotel calm, rested, and ready — the way every trip to Saigon should start

Simple & Seamless

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before booking your Fast Track at Ho Chi Minh Airport. Still have questions? Chat with us on WhatsApp.

You must already have a valid entry document — one of the following:

  • E-Visa (applied online in advance)
  • Visa on Arrival approval letter
  • Visa Exemption (eligible nationalities, 45 days)
  • Temporary Residence Card
  • APEC Business Travel Card

Note: Fast Track is for foreign passport holders only. Vietnamese passport holders use the autogate system.

Fast Track Arrival ([saf_price service="fast_track_arrival"]/person) — our staff meets you at Terminal 2 on landing, guides you through the priority immigration lane and handles visa stamp assistance. You clear immigration in under 20 minutes. Baggage Assistance is available as an optional add-on (+$15/person).

Fast Track Departure ([saf_price service="fast_track_departure"]/person) — we meet you at the T2 departure entrance and guide you through the priority departure immigration lane, so you skip the passport-control queue. Priority Security Screening (+$20/person) and Priority Check-in (+$25/person) are available as optional add-ons.

No. Our service fee covers personal assistance only. Official government fees (such as Visa on Arrival stamping fees) are paid separately and directly to the authorities on the day of service. We will always inform you of any applicable fees in advance.

Yes, a $10 surcharge per person applies for flights during night hours — arrivals between 11:00 PM and 6:00 AM, and departures between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM. This is relevant for many flights at Tan Son Nhat — overnight routes from Seoul, Tokyo, Sydney and other cities often land during these hours. Our service is available 24/7 regardless of flight time.

Book via WhatsApp, email, or the contact form on this page. Just send your flight number, arrival or departure date, number of passengers and chosen service. We confirm within 10 minutes — day or night.

For arrivals, our staff will be waiting inside the Terminal 2 international arrival hall, holding a sign with your name — right after you exit the aerobridge or bus transfer area.

For departures, we meet you at the Terminal 2 departure entrance. We will send you the exact meeting point details after confirmation.

No problem at all. We monitor your flight in real time and adjust accordingly. Our staff will be there whether your flight lands early, on time, or late — as many of our guests have experienced at busy Tan Son Nhat Airport.

Yes, absolutely. Our service works for solo travelers, couples, families and larger groups. Simply let us know the number of passengers when booking. Infants under 2 travel free of charge. Families with young children especially benefit from Fast Track — no standing in a 90-minute queue with kids after a long flight.

We confirm your booking first — no advance payment required. Payment is made via PayPal or credit card (no PayPal account needed). We send a secure payment link after confirmation. We do not accept cash payment.

Yes! Many guests book both services for complete peace of mind — Fast Track Arrival when landing in Ho Chi Minh City, and Fast Track Departure when flying out. Just share both flight details when booking and we'll take care of everything.

Not Fast Track Arrival — you need Fast Track Connection. Fast Track Arrival ends once you are through immigration at Terminal 2; it does not cover the domestic terminal. At Tan Son Nhat that matters more than at most airports: domestic flights leave from two different terminals — T1 for Vietjet Air, T3 for Vietnam Airlines, Pacific Airlines, VASCO, Bamboo Airways and Vietravel Airlines — and T3 is a separate building reached by the free airport shuttle.

Fast Track Connection ([saf_price service="connection"]) covers the whole journey — priority immigration at T2, clear directions to the right terminal, and a second agent waiting there for priority check-in and security screening. See the Connection Service →
